{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Detention should be a last resort, not the default.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will prioritize investments in more effective and cost-efficient community-based alternatives to detention.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will end for-profit detention centers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Any facility where migrants are being detained will be held to the highest standards of care and guarantees their safety and dignity.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"All detention centers will provide access to competent interpreters who speak migrants' native languages and dialects.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Detention of children should be restricted to the shortest possible time.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Access to education and proper care will be ensured for detained children.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Alternatives to detention will be prioritized for individuals with special vulnerabilities, including those suffering from serious physical or mental illness.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Alternatives to detention will be prioritized for individuals with disabilities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Alternatives to detention will be prioritized for elderly individuals.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Alternatives to detention will be prioritized for pregnant or nursing individuals.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Alternatives to detention will be prioritized for individuals who demonstrate that they are primary caretakers of children or an infirm person.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Alternatives to detention will be prioritized for individuals who identify as gay, lesbian, transgender, gender non-conforming, or intersex.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Alternatives to detention will be prioritized when detention is otherwise not in the public interest.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will implement robust mechanisms for oversight, accountability, and transparency to ensure immigration agencies abide by values, the U.S. Constitution, and international law.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
